textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
local parent = element:parent() component("textPadding"):SetInt(3 * game.hudScale() * element:templateVars().scale) component("size"):SetFloat(0.4 * game.hudScale() * element:templateVars().scale) component("multiline"):SetInt(1) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString(parent.ItemTitle) component("layer"):SetString(element:templateVars().layer) component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.001) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1)
local tintR = parent.TintR local tintG = parent.TintG local tintB = parent.TintB component:setColor(tintR, tintG, tintB)

spriteComponent.name: Sprite
spriteComponent.event: component("spriteName"):SetString("gfx/menu/gradient") local targetW = element.Text:absW() + 32 * game.hudScale() local targetH = element.Text:absH() + 16 * game.hudScale() local scaleX = targetW / 150 local scaleY = targetH / 110 component:setScale(Vector2(scaleX, scaleY)) component("layer"):SetString(element:templateVars().layer)

aeComponent.name: SpriteBG
aeComponent.event:
component("offsetCenter"):SetInt(1)
local parent = element:parent() local bgAnimFile = parent.BgAnimationFile local bgAnimName = parent.BgAnimationName if string.len(bgAnimFile) > 0 then component("animationName"):SetString("xml_bin/"..bgAnimFile) component("animation"):SetString(bgAnimName) local scale = 0.75 * game.hudScale() * element:templateVars().scale; component:setScale(Vector2(scale, scale)) component("layer"):SetString(element:templateVars().layer) else component("visible"):SetInt(0) end

aeComponent.name: Sprite
aeComponent.event:
component("offsetCenter"):SetInt(1)
local parent = element:parent() local animFile = parent.AnimationFile local animName = parent.AnimationName if string.len(animFile) > 0 then component("animationName"):SetString("xml_bin/"..animFile) component("animation"):SetString( animName ) local costumeId = parent.CostumeId if costumeId > 0 then game.applyCostumeToAnimComponent(component, costumeId) end local scale = 0.75 * game.hudScale() * element:templateVars().scale; component:setScale(Vector2(scale, scale)) component("layer"):SetString(element:templateVars().layer) else component("visible"):SetInt(0) end

spriteSheetComponent.name: ForcedSpriteSheet
spriteSheetComponent.event:
local parent = element:parent() local spriteName = parent.ForceSpriteName local spriteSheetName = parent.ForceSpriteSheetName if string.len(spriteName) > 0 and string.len(spriteSheetName) > 0 then component("size"):SetFloat(1) component("spriteName"):SetString(spriteName) component("sheetName"):SetString(spriteSheetName)
local hScale = parent:absH()/component:absH() local wScale = parent:absW()/component:absW() component("size"):SetFloat(0.9 * math.min(hScale, wScale))
component("layer"):SetString(element:templateVars().layer) else component("visible"):SetInt(0) end

spriteComponent.name: ForcedSprite
spriteComponent.event:
local parent = element:parent() local spriteName = parent.ForceSpriteName local spriteSheetName = parent.ForceSpriteSheetName if string.len(spriteName) > 0 and string.len(spriteSheetName) == 0 then component("size"):SetFloat(1) component("spriteName"):SetString(spriteName)
local hScale = parent:absH()/component:absH() local wScale = parent:absW()/component:absW() component("size"):SetFloat(0.9 * math.min(hScale, wScale))
component("layer"):SetString(element:templateVars().layer) else component("visible"):SetInt(0) end

textComponent.name: ForcedText
textComponent.event:
local parent = element:parent() component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("autoScale"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED)
component("size"):SetFloat(1) component("text"):SetString(parent.ForceText) component("size"):SetFloat(0.8 * parent:absW()/component:absW())
component("layer"):SetString(element:templateVars().layer)
